text: At its meeting on July 4, 2018, North York Community Council adopted Item NY32.92 which approved the naming of the unassumed street between Rean Drive and Barberry Place as "Karen's Way", and directed that the name be referred to Engineering and Construction Services to confirm that Toronto Police Service, Toronto Fire Services and Toronto Paramedic Services have no objections to the proposed name. This report provides that information to North York Community Council.
North York Community Council: 1. Enacted the by-law to authorize the naming of the unassumed street between Rean Drive and Barberry Place as "Karen's Way".
